Webb, spins the yarn of It was one of those perfect days of early spring when our team left London to give an account of itself in the 52nd National Cross-Country Championship, held on Saturday, March 11th, at Alderley Park, Cheshire, over a course of 10 miles.

When seen at the end of about a mile and a half the field was led by Close (Reading) followed by a bunch including Cohen (Ashcombe) and Pell (Herne Hill). Our first man was Bill Rice 21st, then Patience 26th, followed by Walker, Duffett, Ring, Webb, F.
Webb was second to Trodd, T.C.C., in 440 yds., whilst Ernie Duffett gained us a valuable point by finishing 4th, although he pulled a muscle in the first 100 yds.
